The test image shows a soybean **leaf** with a circular lesion featuring a light tan/white center and a distinct dark brown/black border ring. This "target" or "bull's-eye" pattern is characteristic.

Let me check the part index and then start viewing reference images one by one.

Leaf diseases narrowed to 16 classes. The lesion has a light center with a distinct dark ring - classic "target" pattern. Top candidates: Frogeye_leaf_spot, Phyllosticta_leaf_spot, Septoria_brown_spot, Bacterial_Blight, Bacterial_Pustule. Starting with one image per class.
Frogeye ref shows many small spots - similar pattern but smaller. The test image has one larger, more prominent lesion with white center and black border. Let me check more classes.
Phyllosticta shows some circular lesions with light centers and dark borders - similar to test image. Let me check Septoria_brown_spot and Bacterial_Blight next.
Septoria doesn't match - shows scattered dark spots on yellowing leaves. Let me check Bacterial_Blight.
Bacterial_Blight shows angular spots with yellow halos - not matching. Let me continue surveying remaining leaf classes.
Bean_Pod_Mottle shows mottling/mosaic - not matching. Continuing survey.
I've surveyed 15 classes. None of the non-frogeye/phyllosticta classes match. Using my final view to check Phyllosticta more closely.

**Analysis:**

The test image shows a soybean leaf with:
- One prominent circular lesion with a **white/light tan center** and a **very dark (near-black) distinct ring border**
- A few small scattered dark dots on an otherwise green leaf

Reviewing all 16 reference images:
- **Frogeye_leaf_spot**: Reference showed many small circular spots with gray centers and reddish-brown borders — same pattern, just smaller/earlier stage lesions
- **Phyllosticta_leaf_spot**: First reference (Dise_18) showed lesions with light centers and dark borders on the right side that look visually similar, but second reference (Dise_42) shows marginal lesion — inconsistent
- All other leaf classes (Septoria, Bacterial_Blight, Downy_mildew, Cercospora, SVN virus, Rust, BSR, SDS, Anthracnose, Powdery_Mildew, BPMV, SCN, Bacterial_Pustule) clearly don't match

The single large circular lesion with light necrotic center and dark reddish-brown/black ring is the hallmark mature **Frogeye leaf spot** pattern. The description confirms: "gray centers with reddish purple margins" on mature lesions. The few small scattered dark dots on the leaf are consistent with additional early-stage frogeye infections.
